import { createJournal, journalActionAllowed } from "/src/ui/journal.ts";
import { h } from "/src/ui/dom.ts";
import { openWindow } from "/src/ui/sheet.ts";
/** A journal routes existing actions; Rust remains the authority on readiness. */
export function openJournal(app, route, anchor) {
	const owner = app.engine;
	let off = () => {};
	let panel = null;
	const read = () => {
		const journal = app.lineage.journal;
		if (app.engine !== owner || !journal) throw Error(
			/* copy:none */
			"missing journal snapshot"
		);
		return {
			identity: JSON.stringify([
				journal.seed,
				journal.bloodline_id,
				journal.heir
			]),
			journal
		};
	};
	openWindow(() => {
		if (!app.lineage.journal) return h(
			"div",
			{ class: "sheet-body" },
			/* copy:callout */
			"Journal unavailable"
		);
		panel = createJournal({
			read,
			action: async (action, entryId) => {
				if (app.engine !== owner) return false;
				const current = read().journal.chapters.flatMap((chapter) => chapter.entries).find((entry) => entry.id === entryId);
				if (!current || !journalActionAllowed(current) || !current.action || current.action.kind !== action.kind || current.action.target !== action.target) return false;
				if (action.kind === "build_town") return owner.buildTown ? app.mutate(() => owner.buildTown(action.target)) : false;
				if (action.kind === "hire") return owner.hire ? app.mutate(() => owner.hire(action.target)) : false;
				return route(action.kind === "delve" ? "delve" : action.target);
			},
			swapQuest: async () => app.engine === owner && !!owner.swapQuest ? app.mutate(() => owner.swapQuest()) : false
		});
		off = app.onChange(() => {
			void panel?.refresh();
		});
		void panel.refresh();
		return panel.el;
	}, {
		anchor,
		material: "journal",
		stay: true,
		onClose: () => {
			off();
			panel?.dispose();
		}
	});
}
